basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming Maria Style home in the prime location of Sunny Visitacion Valley. This delightful residence features 3 bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. The bright and airy living room features hardwood floors, view windows and a cozy fireplace. The formal dining area seamlessly connects to a spacious kitchen. Two of the bedrooms overlook the tranquil backyard. The lower level includes a versatile room with a half bathroom and separate entrance. The spacious garage with high ceilings opens to an expansive backyard. Conveniently located near 101/280 freeways, Bayshore Caltrain Station, MUNI transit, and McLaren Park, this home offers easy access to Leland Ave cafes, restaurants, and shops, as well as the vibrant San Bruno Ave. Having been in the family for over 50 years, this home is ready for the next family to make it their own with some TLC. Don't miss this opportunity!
